verified.summary: The agent successfully executed the reach task once, empirically finding that http://127.0.0.1:47318/skill-bridge/v3/skill/search answers and that http://10.244.7.19:8096/skill-bridge/v3/skill/search does not; outcome records consistently validate skill B and mark skill A wrong.
